description.value: Wela is a fast-casual health restaurant in downtown Vancouver specializing in globally-inspired bowls, wraps, and superfood smoothies built around a Thai-rooted 'find your balance' philosophy. Founded in 2019, it offers a wide spectrum of customizable options spanning vegan, gluten-free, and omnivore diets, making it a practical and satisfying stop for touring cyclists seeking a quick nutritious meal. The restaurant also partners with Too Good To Go to reduce food waste, reflecting its sustainability-minded ethos.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms WELA at 765 Nelson St. is an active fast-casual health restaurant with takeout, dine-in, and delivery; menu pages explicitly label items Ⓥ, GF, and dairy-free, corroborating OSM diet tags. Bike parking, water refill, and washrooms are not mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those remain null. One notable OSM data quality issue: brand:wikipedia=en:Freshii is incorrect — the website makes clear WELA is an independent brand with Thai-influenced origins, not a Freshii franchise.
